material_type.evidence: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were isolated and lysed with 0.8% Triton X-100, protease and phosphatase inhibitors.

sample_source.evidence: Venous blood samples of 4 mL were collected in Vacutainer ACD tubes (BD Biosciences, BD367756) from patients KS-I and KS-II, and respective controls and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were isolated.
Age and sex-matched children with no neurodevelopmental conditions or significant health conditions were recruited for the control group.
